# Routing — Chapter 5B (Economic Wellbeing)

## Decision Summary

| chunk_id | decision | applicable 5B lenses | rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| U0001 | include | 5B.3, 5B.9 | Tax/fiscal rule text (IEPS stimulus schedule) and timely shock-response |
| U0002 | include | 5B.3, 5B.9 | Quantitative stimulus tables and effective-period metadata for the same shock-response |

---

## Included Chunks

### U0001 — `extracted HTML block 1`

**chunk_text_excerpt:** "ACUERDO por el que se dan a conocer los porcentajes, los montos del estímulo fiscal y las cuotas disminuidas del impuesto especial sobre producción y servicios... correspondien"

**Adjacent context:**
- Adjacent chunk `U0002` carries the per-fuel percentage, peso/liter, and quota tables and the 10–16 December 2022 effective period and signatory block.
- Parent instrument hierarchy: First Article of the 27 Dec 2016 IEPS stimulus Decree (and subsequent modifications) and First Article of the 4 Mar 2022 complementary automotive-fuel stimulus Decree (DOF). Issuer: Titular de la Unidad de Política de Ingresos No Tributarios, SHCP (Karina Ramírez Arras). Ruled period: 10–16 Dec 2022; signed 8 Dec 2022.

**applicable_question_ids:**
- 5B.3 — credible tax/fiscal rules protecting stability and long-term investment (IEPS fiscal-stimulus decree implementing tax-rate and quota reductions on automotive fuels under an established legal framework).
- 5B.9 — timely, funded shock-response measures (price-shock mitigation for automotive fuels for the 10–16 Dec 2022 window, with explicit legal basis).

**relevance:** high. The chunk is the legal preamble of an active fiscal-stimulus rule executing under standing decrees; it is direct primary evidence of a counter-shock fiscal intervention operating inside a pre-committed tax-rule framework.

**exclusion_reason:** none.

---

### U0002 — `extracted HTML block 2`

**chunk_text_excerpt:** "Combustible Porcentaje de Estímulo / Gasolina menor a 91 octanos 26.96% / Gasolina menor a 91 octanos $1.4803 / Diésel $3.6071 / ... Artículo Cuarto ... $0.0000 ... TRANSITORIO ÚNICO ... Ciudad de México, a 08 de diciembre de 2022"

**Adjacent context:**
- Directly continues the preamble from `U0001`; together they constitute one Acuerdo (173/2022) published in the DOF and indexed at `https://sidof.segob.gob.mx/notas/docFuente/5673810`.
- Effective period 10–16 Dec 2022; entry into force the day after publication; signatory block identifies the issuing authority and the substitution-of-powers clause ("en suplencia del C. Subsecretario de Hacienda y Crédito Público").

**applicable_question_ids:**
- 5B.3 — operationalization of the standing IEPS stimulus rule: per-fuel percentages, peso/liter amounts, reduced IEPS quotas, and complementary-stimulus quantities — quantitative compliance-with-published-fiscal-rule evidence.
- 5B.9 — quantified magnitude and targeting of the shock response (gasolina <91 octanos 26.96% / $1.4803/l; diésel 59.77% / $3.6071/l; gasolina ≥91 octanos and non-fossil fuels at 0% stimulus; complementary stimulus = $0 for the period).

**relevance:** high. The tables are the auditable, machine-readable execution record of the fiscal rule for the 10–16 Dec 2022 window; they are the measurable counterpart to the preamble in `U0001`.

**exclusion_reason:** none.

---

## Lenses Not Matched

| lens | reason not matched in any chunk |
|---|---|
| 5B.1 | No legislative agenda, budget execution, or policy-mix text describing pursuit of broad-based sustainable prosperity versus rents or patronage. |
| 5B.2 | No appointment, qualification, or tenure-of-economic-officials content beyond a single signatory identification. |
| 5B.4 | No competition, entrepreneurship, property, trade, investment, or job-creation rule text. |
| 5B.5 | No anti-corruption, procurement, audit, or capture-remediation content. |
| 5B.6 | No budget execution, infrastructure, education, health, technology, or administrative-capacity content. |
| 5B.7 | No transparency, independent audit, correction-of-failure, or information-publication content beyond routine DOF publication. |
| 5B.8 | No distributional incidence content across classes, regions, genders, or groups. |
| 5B.10 | No trajectory, cumulative, or comparative content versus an inherited baseline. |

## Excluded Chunks

None.

## Routing Audit

- Every supplied `chunk_id` received exactly one decision (2 of 2).
- No chunk was excluded.
- Included chunks cite every applicable 5B lens and no others.
- Adjacent context is anchored to the same Acuerdo (173/2022) so that the preamble (`U0001`) and the quantitative tables + effective-period + signatory block (`U0002`) can be read as one auditable fiscal-rule execution event.
